items.title: Rising Property Tax Bills: Why Growth Is Not to Blame
items.author: Aliza Abidi
items.content: Economic growth expands the tax base, but increasing property tax bills are largely the result of local government spending.

items.title: Is AI Buildout Driving Up Mortgage Rates?
items.author: Aliza Abidi
items.content: As tech giants ramp up debt to fund unprecedented AI investment, they’re drawing on the same pool of capital that finances mortgages and other investments. Could the AI buildout keep rates elevated, even as it promises a more productive future?

items.title: What a Family Dollar Dispute Revealed About Nuisance Law
items.author: Aliza Abidi
items.content: A Fort Worth property owner’s lawsuit against Family Dollar went all the way to the Texas Supreme Court where it went down the drain.
